headline: US Homebuilder Confidence Hits Lowest in More Than 14.5 Years in November
summary: The NAHB and Wells Fargo housing market index fell four points this month to 25, its lowest level since April 2012.
why: The NAHB housing market index tracks builder sentiment in the US, a leading indicator for residential construction activity, mortgage demand and housing-related stocks.
original_headline: Confianza de constructores de viviendas en EU toca mínimo de más de 14 años y medio en noviembre
